comment: Layer-specific oelint-adv constant DB. oelint-adv auto-loads 'oelint.constants.json' from the layer root (the directory holding conf/layer.conf) whenever a file from this layer is linted, so no --constantmods is needed. It lists the real variables, functions, overrides and includes that oelint cannot resolve when run standalone, outside a full bitbake build: they come from openembedded-core and meta-freescale, which this layer depends on but which are not part of the scan.
